output.reason: [ev-a7745aa0308c] and [ev-7f9e21d03a66] say the v1alpha1 EnvironmentConfig API is dropped (fixes #6163; the docs already use v1beta1). [ev-07cdaccca797] shows the v1alpha1 EnvironmentConfig types file removed and the apiextensions.crossplane.io_environmentconfigs CRD changed. When an API version is removed, requests that use it are rejected, so resource-rejected/high is the right kind. However, the proposed statement over-claims: the evidence supports rejection of manifests and clients that use v1alpha1, not that already-stored EnvironmentConfig objects are rejected or become unusable, so I corrected the statement.

correction.statement: Crossplane 2.0.0 drops the v1alpha1 EnvironmentConfig API version from the EnvironmentConfig CRD. Manifests, tooling or clients that still use apiVersion apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1alpha1 for EnvironmentConfig are rejected and must move to v1beta1.

consequence.statement: After the upgrade, applying or requesting EnvironmentConfig resources through the removed v1alpha1 API version is rejected because the version is no longer defined in the CRD. Manifests, GitOps sources and clients still pinned to v1alpha1 fail.
consequence.remediation: Update EnvironmentConfig manifests and clients to use the v1beta1 API version, which the docs already reference, before upgrading to Crossplane 2.0.0.
